purpose: Only the open-set gate changes. Branch A (E180 adversarially trained EEGNet) and branch B (E65 correlation-logSPD PCA-96 / k=12 prototypes) are loaded frozen from the E180 artifacts; identity discrimination is untouched. Build five gate signals, fuse them with Train-only weights, and measure the ten gates. Core question: can fusion lift the gate ROC enough for Test S1 rejection and Test S2 acceptance to both reach 0.75?

frozen_source.note: read-only; E181 never writes into the E180 directory and never retrains the production identity model

signals.g_dist: branch B score = -nearest-prototype euclidean distance (E180 gate), z-scored by Train OOF mean/std
signals.g_margin: branch A top1 - top2 softmax probability
signals.g_entropy: branch A sum p log p (= -entropy; larger = more confident = more known)
signals.orientation: all five are oriented so that larger = more likely known; each z-scored with Train OOF mean/std (Train-only, population std)
signals.computation: Train OOF <- 5-block OOF branch A logits + 5-block OOF branch B scores; Test <- frozen full model logits + frozen branch B prototypes

fusion.extra: 4-way and 5-way equal weights (reported as extra, not required by the task)
fusion.selection_rule: argmax pooled Train LOSO gate AUC; ties broken by fold-mean AUC then by fewer signals
fusion.forbidden: Test metrics are never used for weights, thresholds, PCA, prototypes or model selection
fusion.subject_level: LOSO = leave-one-identity-out; branch A LOSO probe models are trained on pm & fit_rows only (19 identities, fit fraction) and evaluated on the 0.6<frac<=0.8 window, mirroring the branch B LOSO protocol; they are probes only and never replace the production model

threshold.rule: tau(a) = quantile(Train OOF fused score, 1 - a), E170/E180 convention
threshold.decision: fused gate >= tau -> branch A argmax, else label 0

loso_probe.eval_rows: window rows 0.6 < frac <= 0.8: known = enrolled identities, unknown = held-out identity
loso_probe.why_retrain: the production model saw all 20 identities, so its confidence on a held-out identity is not an open-set signal; a leave-identity-out probe model is the only honest way to measure the branch A confidence signals on Train
loso_probe.cost_note: 20 x 30 epochs on ~5.4k rows, saved under cache/loso_model_*.pt

attack.domain: Train window block 0.6 < frac <= 0.8; stratified cap 400 per task; identical subset to E180 (same seed)
attack.eps_definition: L-infinity bound = eps * per-trial global RMS; step = 2*eps/steps*RMS, sign gradient, random start

goals.A: impersonation: maximise (best wrong branch-A logit - true logit)/T
goals.B: broad confusion: maximise (logsumexp over wrong branch-A logits - true logit)/T
goals.C: boundary impersonation: maximise (next-identity logit - true logit)/T
goals.D: gate evasion: maximise the FUSED gate score (all five signals are differentiable)

attack.reading: #7 = lowest RA over all eps x goals, #8 = lowest ASafeR over the same grid

capacity_probe.purpose: gate #1 only (Train in-sample accuracy = 1.00); does not change the production decision path
variants: frozen E180 full model, logits argmax
same model, in-sample leave-one-out 1-NN on the 128-d pooled embedding (capacity-only, memorisation)
same model, block-OOF 1-NN on the pooled embedding (honest generalisation check)
frozen E180 full model continued for 15 epochs with the E180 optimiser settings (AdamW 2e-3, cosine) (more-epochs probe)

reporting.test_official: N/A: Test has no identity labels, so AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: Test predictions are written before the Session column is read; Session is used only for the #9/#10 audit
reporting.train_vs_test_auc: Train LOSO gate AUC drives every weight/threshold decision; the Test diagnostic AUC (S1 vs S2) is reported only as an audit number
